title: Marcus Fenix's final choice in Gears of War 3

description:

How the Gears of War trilogy ends for Marcus Fenix and his father. Spoilers for Gears of War 3.

scenes.text: Marcus Fenix found his father alive, then watched him die.
On the island of Azura, Adam Fenix revealed a weapon that could wipe out the glowing Imulsion destroying Sera.
To test it, he had infected himself. Firing it meant his own death.
The wave swept across the planet, ending the Lambent and the Locust. Adam turned to dust in front of his son.
Then Queen Myrrah mocked his grief, and Marcus ended her with Dom's knife.
